answer: Stop selling seats; match them. Each epoch a standing identity opens a desk of capacity k, paid from its balance; submitters rank desks, desks rank submissions by how unlike their reading history each is, and deferred acceptance pairs them. Pay follows a match only; in a stable match no bid outranks a preference, so a bribe cannot lift a copy over a preferred stranger. A thousand clones share one reading history, tie at the bottom of every desk, and clear at most k; each needs its own reader to stake a licence. Cloning buys a queue, not an edge: much copper, one pigment, identical walnuts.
